words.core_concept: carrying oneself higher for what one has – 因手里有的东西把自己端得高一点
words.core_image: 他把修好的柜子摆在门口，谁进来都要停一下让人看两眼
examples: She was proud of her daughter's progress.
He is too proud to admit a mistake.
semantic_expansions: 自豪的：为做成的事心里舒展
得意的：那股舒展露在脸上
高傲的：端得过高，看别人就低了

words.origin: 古英语 pyffan（吹气、鼓气），拟声词，模仿吹气那一下的声音
words.native_definition: to send out a short burst of air or smoke, or such a burst
words.core_concept: a short burst of air pushed out – 短短推出去的一下气
words.core_image: 蜡烛前嘴一撮，气短短送出去，火苗歪了一下，烟丝往上飘
examples: He blew out a puff of smoke.
She was puffing after climbing the stairs.
semantic_expansions: 一股：短短出来的那一下气或烟
喷出：把气短促地送出去
喘气：一下接一下地送气，气不够用时
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 pullian（拔、拽、揪），更早词源不明，日耳曼语其他分支少见同形
words.native_definition: to move something towards oneself by taking hold of it
words.core_concept: taking hold and bringing it towards oneself – 抓住了往自己这边带
words.core_image: 绳子绕在手上，脚往后蹬，身子往后倒，箱子一寸一寸挪过来
examples: She pulled the door open with both hands.
He gave the rope a hard pull.
semantic_expansions: 拉：抓住东西往自己这边带
拽：带得更用力些
拖：带着走，东西贴着地面
拉力：这个动作的力气本身

words.origin: 中古荷兰语 pompe / 中古低地德语 pumpe（抽水管），多认为是拟声词；更早词源不明
words.native_definition: a device that moves liquid or gas from one place to another
words.core_concept: driving liquid along by working a handle up and down – 一压一提把液体赶着走
words.core_image: 井台上一压一提，头几下只出气，第十几下水才涌上来
examples: The pump broke and the field went dry.
He pumped up the bicycle tyre.
semantic_expansions: 泵：靠一压一提把液体赶走的那个器件
抽水机：专抽水的那种
抽：用它把液体吸上来
打气：同一个动作往里送气而不是抽水
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 pupille ← 拉丁语 pupillus / pupilla（受监护的孩子，也指眼中那个小人像）← pupa（小女孩、玩偶）
words.native_definition: a child at school, or the dark opening at the centre of the eye
words.core_concept: the little figure held inside – 里头装着的那个小人
words.core_image: 凑得很近看对方眼睛，正中那个小黑洞里有个极小的自己在动
examples: The teacher called each pupil by name.
His pupils widened in the dark room.
semantic_expansions: 学生：受人管教的孩子，拉丁语本指受监护者
小学生：年纪更小的那一档
瞳孔：眼睛正中那个洞，里面照出对面人的小像

words.origin: 古法语 pur ← 拉丁语 purus（干净的、不掺杂的）
words.native_definition: not mixed with anything else, or free of dirt
words.core_concept: nothing else in it – 里头没有别的东西
words.core_image: 玻璃杯举到窗前，从上看到底一色，杯底连一粒沙都没有
examples: This shirt is made of pure cotton.
The village drinks pure spring water.
semantic_expansions: 纯的：只有一样东西，没掺别的
纯净的：连脏东西也没有
纯粹的：抽象的事情上也这么说，不夹杂别的成分

words.origin: 古英语 purs ← 晚期拉丁语 bursa（皮袋、兽皮）← 希腊语 byrsa（生皮）
words.native_definition: a small bag for carrying money
words.core_concept: a small hide bag drawn tight at the mouth – 口上抽紧的小皮袋
words.core_image: 巴掌大的一个软皮袋，口上一根绳抽紧，捏起来里面硬币轻轻响
examples: She found two coins at the bottom of her purse.
He left his purse on the counter.
semantic_expansions: 钱包：装钱用的小袋
小钱袋：同一样东西，强调它小
财力：手头能拿出来的钱，从装钱的那个袋子引申

words.origin: 古英语 cwēn（女子、妻子、王之妻）← 原始日耳曼语 *kwēniz（女人）
words.native_definition: a woman who rules a country, or the wife of a king
words.core_concept: the woman seated at the top – 坐在最上头的那个女子
words.core_image: 台阶最上头坐着一个女子，底下一排人低着头等她开口
examples: The queen opened the new hospital.
She was crowned queen at twenty-five.
semantic_expansions: 女王：自己当国的那个女子
王后：国王的妻子，位在王侧
皇后：帝制下同一位置的称法

words.origin: 古英语 cwic（活的、有生气的）← 原始日耳曼语 *kwikwaz（活着的）；活物才动得起来，故转指动作利落
words.native_definition: taking only a short time, or moving with speed
words.core_concept: over before you can follow it – 还没跟上就已经过去了
words.core_image: 浅水里一道影子，还没看清就到了石头那边，水面只剩一圈纹
examples: She gave a quick answer and walked on.
He is quick at picking up new words.
semantic_expansions: 快的：占用的时间短
迅速的：同一件事，语气更正式
敏捷的：身手或反应跟得上，不只是时间短
很快：作副词用，说动作发生得急

words.origin: 古诺斯语 rás（奔跑、急流）；表「种族」一义另出法语 race ← 意大利语 razza（族类），更早词源不明，两支同形不同源
words.native_definition: a contest of speed, or a group of people sharing descent
words.core_concept: rushing to be first – 抢着头一个到
words.core_image: 一声哨响，十几个人同时朝前冲，都盯着地上那条白线
examples: He won the race by two seconds.
They raced to catch the last bus.
semantic_expansions: 赛跑：比谁跑得快的那种比试
比赛：泛指抢先的比试，不限于跑
疾走：动词用，急急地赶
种族：这一义出法语一支，指同一血脉传下来的一群人

words.origin: 中古荷兰语 rec（架子、拉开的框），与 recken（拉开、抻）相关，原始日耳曼语一支表「伸开」
words.native_definition: a frame with bars for holding or hanging things
words.core_concept: bars spread apart to hold things – 撑开的几根条，把东西架住
words.core_image: 几根横木隔着空档搭成一层层，盘子立在缝里，互不挨着
examples: Put the wet plates on the rack.
He was racked by doubt for weeks.
semantic_expansions: 架子：横条撑开、东西搁在缝里的那种框
搁架：同一样东西，专指搁放用的
折磨：旧刑具把人往两头抻开，故引申为把人拉扯得难受

words.origin: 法语 raquette ← 意大利语 racchetta ← 阿拉伯语 rāḥat（手掌）；表「喧闹」一义为另一支拟声词，与球拍无关
words.native_definition: a bat with strings used in tennis, or a loud unpleasant noise
words.core_concept: a strung palm on a handle – 装在柄上的一只绷了线的手掌
words.core_image: 一个椭圆的框，中间绷满细线，握把上缠着布，挥起来带风声
examples: She bought a new racket before the match.
The children made a racket upstairs.
semantic_expansions: 球拍：绷着线的那个框，本象是张开的手掌
喧闹：这一义出拟声一支，指乱七八糟的响
吵闹声：同一支，指那阵响本身

words.native_definition: a system that finds distant objects by sending out radio waves
words.core_concept: sending a wave out and reading what comes back – 打一道波出去，看回来的是什么
words.core_image: 屏幕上一根线绕着圆心扫，扫到一处就留下一个亮点，转一圈亮点又挪了
examples: The ship's radar picked up a small boat.
Radar warned them of the coming storm.
semantic_expansions: 雷达：靠发出无线电波、再收回波来定位远处东西的那套装置

words.origin: 或出古诺斯语 rögg（粗毛、蓬乱的绒），或由 ragged（破烂的）反向构成；更早词源不明
words.native_definition: a piece of old torn cloth
words.core_concept: cloth torn out of use – 撕下来、不再当衣服的那块布
words.core_image: 从旧衬衫上撕下来的一块，边上全是抽出来的线头，油污搓不掉
examples: He wiped his hands on an oily rag.
Her coat was worn to rags.
semantic_expansions: 破布：撕坏了、边上散线的那块布
抹布：拿这种布来擦东西时的叫法

words.origin: 古法语 rage ← 通俗拉丁语 rabia ← 拉丁语 rabies（狂乱、发狂）← rabere（发狂）；英语里同族只此一词
words.native_definition: violent anger that cannot be held back
words.core_concept: anger past the point of holding – 拦不住了的那股火
words.core_image: 他一脚踹翻椅子，脖子上的筋鼓起来，话都说不成句
examples: He shook with rage when he heard the news.
The fire raged for three days.
semantic_expansions: 盛怒：气到压不下去
暴怒：同一股气发作出来，更凶
肆虐：风火水患也这么说，指它撒开了没人拦得住

words.origin: 苏格兰语 raid（骑马出击），是古英语 rād（骑行、路途）的方言变体 ← rīdan（骑）；与 road 同支
words.native_definition: a sudden short attack on a place
words.core_concept: riding in, striking, riding out – 骑进去打一下就骑走
words.core_image: 天没亮马蹄声就到了村口，抢完粮食掉头就走，没打算留
examples: The soldiers made a raid on the camp at dawn.
Police raided the shop that night.
semantic_expansions: 突袭：说来就来、不打招呼的那一下
袭击：同一动作，泛用些
查抄：警察突然进屋搜查，也是这个来势

words.origin: 古英语 regn（雨）← 原始日耳曼语 *regnaz（雨）
words.native_definition: water falling from clouds in drops
words.core_concept: water coming down out of the sky in drops – 天上一点一点落下来的水
words.core_image: 檐下先是几点砸在水泥地上，砸出深色圆斑，一会儿连成一片湿
examples: The rain started just after we left.
It rained hard all afternoon.
semantic_expansions: 雨：从云里落下来的水
下雨：这件事正在发生
雨水：落下来的那些水本身

words.native_definition: to move something to a higher position, or to increase it
words.core_concept: making something go up – 使一样东西往上去
words.core_image: 两手托住箱底往上送，胳膊伸直了才把它搁上柜顶
examples: She raised her hand to ask something.
They raised money for the village school.
semantic_expansions: 举起：把东西托到高处
提高：数目或程度往上走
抚养：把孩子一点点带大，也是往上带
筹集：把钱一笔笔凑上来，钱数往上长

words.native_definition: a tool with a row of teeth on a long handle for gathering
words.core_concept: teeth dragged across the ground to gather – 一排齿拖过地面把东西拢起
words.core_image: 一排铁齿在土上拖过去，落叶被拢成一堆，土面留下平行的浅沟
examples: He used a rake to clear the fallen leaves.
She raked the soil flat before planting.
semantic_expansions: 耙：那件带齿的工具
耙子：同一件东西的口语叫法
搂拢：用它把散在地上的东西拢到一处

words.origin: 古法语 randon（急冲、乱跑）← randir（疾行）← 法兰克语 *rant（奔跑），日耳曼语源经法语入英
words.native_definition: happening without any plan or pattern
words.core_concept: no rule behind where each one lands – 每一个落在哪儿都没有规矩管着
words.core_image: 一把豆子撒在桌面上，落处各不相同，谁也说不出下一粒会滚到哪
examples: The names were picked in random order.
He made a random guess and got it right.
semantic_expansions: 随机的：哪一个被挑到全无规律
任意的：不加挑选，抓着哪个算哪个
胡乱的：连该有的次序也不顾

words.native_definition: the set of values or things lying between two limits
words.core_concept: everything laid out between the two ends – 摊在两端之间的那一段
words.core_image: 尺子上标出两个刻度，中间那一段全算在内，两头之外就不算
examples: Prices range from ten to fifty pounds.
A range of hills lay to the north.
semantic_expansions: 范围：两个界限之间的那一段
幅度：这一段有多宽
山脉：一排山依次排开
排列：动词用，把东西一个接一个摆开

words.origin: 古法语 ranc（一排、行列）← 法兰克语 *hring（环、圈），日耳曼语源；另有古英语 ranc（高壮的）表「茂密、难闻」一义
words.native_definition: a position in a scale of importance, or to place in such a scale
words.core_concept: which slot in the line one stands in – 在那一排里站的是哪一格
words.core_image: 队伍站成一排，从右往左个子递减，谁站哪一格一眼看得出
examples: He rose to the rank of captain.
She ranks second in the class.
semantic_expansions: 等级：一排格子里的某一格
职级：军中或机构里的那一格
排名：按高低把人摆进各格
列：本义那一排本身

words.native_definition: to hit a hard surface with a quick light blow
words.core_concept: one short hard knock – 短促干脆的一下敲
words.core_image: 指节在门板上连敲三下，声音干脆，屋里人立刻应了
examples: He rapped on the window to get her attention.
She heard a rap at the door.
semantic_expansions: 敲击：在硬面上短促打一下
急敲：连着几下，催人应门
说唱：一句句踩着节拍打出来的唱法，取的是敲点那个劲

words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 raper ← 拉丁语 rapere（夺走、强取）；英语同族仅 rapid 一词，不足以另立词根
words.native_definition: the crime of forcing sexual intercourse on someone, or the violent spoiling of a place

examples: The court found him guilty of rape.
The rape of the forest went on for years.
semantic_expansions: 强奸：以暴力强迫他人性交的罪行
掠夺：把别处的东西强行夺走
破坏：山林土地被强夺滥用，也用这个词

words.origin: 拉丁语 rapidus（迅疾的）← rapere（夺走），夺东西的手快，故转指快
words.native_definition: happening or moving very fast
words.core_concept: fast enough to snatch things along – 快到能把东西一把带走
words.core_image: 河面到这一段忽然窄了，水挤过去打出白沫，木片一晃就冲出视线
examples: The city has seen rapid growth in ten years.
A rapid change in weather caught them out.
semantic_expansions: 迅速的：变化或动作在很短时间里完成
急速的：同一意思，语气更紧
湍急的：水流快得推得住东西

words.origin: 古法语 rare ← 拉丁语 rarus（稀疏的、不密的）；另有表「肉半生」的 rare 出古英语 hrēre（半熟的），同形不同源
words.native_definition: not often found or seen
words.core_concept: thinly spread, so seldom met with – 分布得疏，因此不常碰上
words.core_image: 山道上走了一整天，只在石缝里看到一株，别处再没有第二株
examples: This stamp is very rare and worth a lot.
Snow is rare in this part of the country.
semantic_expansions: 稀有的：数目少，不容易得到
罕见的：不常见到，着眼于遇见的次数
稀薄的：空气之类分布得疏，也用这个词

words.origin: 中古英语 rasch（急躁的）← 原始日耳曼语 *raskaz（快的）；表「皮疹」一义另出古法语 rasche（擦刮出的疮），两支同形不同源
words.native_definition: acting too quickly without thinking, or a patch of red spots on the skin
words.core_concept: moving before thinking – 想都没想就先动
words.core_image: 话没听完他就签了字，笔一放才想起没问价钱
examples: It was rash of him to sign without reading.
